scripts.text:
This rock contains unidentified minerals.
It's not possible to mine more than the limit.
scripts.translation:
这块岩石含有未确认矿石。
无法开采超过上限的数量。

scripts.text: Nothing was caught.
scripts.translation: 没有抓到任何东西。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
scripts.translation: 鱼在水里游动。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
您的物品栏已满。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Outsider?
Outsiders have been coming more frequently.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
外来者？
最近外来者来的越来越频繁了。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
It seems like our superiors have permitted your entrance, so I won't stop you either.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
看来上级已经允许你进入了，那我也不会阻拦你。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
My name is Arc.
By the way, hmm... Can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我的名字是阿克。
顺便问一下，嗯...你能听懂我在说什么吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Shake my head
scripts.translation: 摇头

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Did you just say 'Yes'?
Can't believe we understand eachother!
When did you learn our language?
What is your race called?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什么？你刚才说“是”吗？
真不敢相信我们能互相理解！
你是什么时候学会我们语言的？
你们种族叫什么名字？

scripts.text: - I show my ring to Arc and explain everything including how I ended up here... -
scripts.translation: - 我向阿克展示我的戒指，并解释了包括我如何来到这里在内的一切... -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
So...hmm, That's how it is...
The source of that huge shock and mysterious explosion...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
原来如此...嗯，事情是这样的...
那个巨大的冲击和神秘的爆炸的源头...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Quite an interesting story.
That's why you humans were exploring here and there...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真是有趣的故事。
原来你们人类一直在到处探索...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Now I clearly understand that you are not sent by the giants of Manuk.
Thank you for telling me these interesting stories.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
现在我很清楚，你不是马努克巨人派来的。
谢谢你告诉我这些有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Oh? Is that so?
We use different languages as expected...
That's a bit frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
哦？是吗？
果然我们使用的语言不同...
这有点令人沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
By the way, you...
No, never mind...
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
顺便问一下，你...
不，算了...
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, right. {0}!
That's a strange pronunciation.
I might mispronunce it, so please understand...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，对了。{0}！
这个发音有点奇怪。
我可能会读错，请多包涵...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Anyways, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
总之，我有件事想拜托你。可以吗？

scripts.text: What favor?
scripts.translation: 什么忙？

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 现在不行。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Um...Ah..It's...
A little...complicated...
- Arc looks around to check if someone else is around. Satisfied you're alone he continues with his story in a low tone. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克环顾四周，确认周围没有其他人。满意地确认只有你之后，他压低声音继续讲述他的故事。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Frankly, I'm worried about a friend of mine who left without permission saying that she's going to check on your camp. She hasn't come back since then.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
老实说，我很担心我的一个朋友。她未经许可就离开了，说要去查看你们的营地。从那以后她就一直没回来。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
But, I can't leave this post to look for her 'cause I have a duty to guard the research data stored here.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
但是，我不能离开岗位去找她，因为我有职责守卫存放在这里的实验数据。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Since she left without permission, I can't even report to my superiors... that will just end up as a bigger problem.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
因为她未经许可离开，我甚至不能向上级报告...那样只会引发更大的麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The thought of it just worries me...
As a matter of fact, we are trying not to have any contact with the giants of Manuk so we stay away from each other's territory.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
想到这些我就很担心...
事实上，我们正在尽量避免与马努克的巨人接触，所以我们各自远离对方的领地。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
That camp of yours is located in the area that has been acting as the neutral zone between our two races...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你们的营地正好位于作为我们两个种族之间中立区的区域...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If she has gotten close to their side then she might have gone over to the snow fields...
That will make it even more difficult for us to look for her...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果她靠近了他们那边，她可能已经进入了雪原...
那样我们寻找她就会更加困难...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The Manuk giants might misunderstand this as provoking them...Couldn't they?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
马努克的巨人可能会误解这是挑衅...不是吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...the point is, you want me to look for your friend. Right?
Because you can't do it yourself from all these complicated situations?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...重点就是，你想让我去找你的朋友。对吧？
因为你自己无法在这些复杂的情况下行动？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Exactly!
You're quite observant.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
没错！
你很敏锐。

scripts.text: Sure, I will do it.
scripts.translation: 当然，我会去做的。

scripts.text: Sorry, can't help you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, I'm going to need more information if I'm going to look for her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，如果我要去找她，我需要更多的信息。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You don't have to worry about that...
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
不用担心...
^4d4dff泰拉^000000有个习惯，会用植物打结来标记目的地。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She does it so that she won't get lost.
If you find a trail of knotted plants it should lead you to where she is.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她这样做是为了防止迷路。
如果你发现一串打结的植物，顺着它们应该就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It can be hard to look for them, but it's better than doing nothing...
Please, I beg of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
虽然找起来可能很困难，但总比什么都不做强...
拜托了，求求你了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, and please keep this a secret from the other Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，还有，请对其他拉菲涅斯保密。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Remember {0}... you must keep this to yourself...
Please, find her.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
记住{0}...这件事必须保密...
拜托了，找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It sure was an unreasonable favor...
You too were sent here to carry on a mission...
That was thoughtless of me...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
这确实是个过分的要求...
你也是被派来执行任务的...
是我考虑不周了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Is that so? Of course.
You were sent here to carry on your own mission...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
是吗？当然。
你也是被派来执行自己的任务的...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
^4d4dffTerra^000000 has a habit of making a knot out of plants to mark her destination.
Keep that in mind when searching for her. And don't tell any other Laphine's about her missing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
^4d4dff泰拉^000000有个习惯，会用植物打结来标记目的地。
寻找她时请留意这一点。另外，不要告诉其他拉菲涅斯她失踪的事。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You {0} are the only one I could ask for help...
Do me this favor please.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}，你是唯一能帮我的人...
请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Did you find anything?
Have you found any knotted plants?
Yeah, that's the mark
that Terra leaves.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你找到什么了吗？
有没有发现打结的植物？
对，那就是
泰拉留下的标记。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Keep it up and find her
for me.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
继续找下去，
替我找到她。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah, Well met!
What do I do now?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊，幸会！
我现在该怎么办？！

scripts.text: What? What happened?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？发生什么事了？

scripts.text: - Arc looks like he was thrown into confusion about something. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克看起来陷入了某种困惑之中。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Terra came back!!!
but, she was covered all over with wounds...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
泰拉回来了！！！
但是，她浑身都是伤...

scripts.text: Covered with wounds?
scripts.translation: 浑身是伤？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
She didn't even get treatment!
She just took the Bradium with that exhausted body!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她甚至没有接受治疗！
就带着那副疲惫的身体拿走了魔力之石！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Didn't even tell me the reason!
I told her no, but she wouldn't listen to me!
It happened all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
连理由都没告诉我！
我明明拒绝了，但她不听我的！
事情发生得太突然了。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!
What shoud I do now?
What do I have to do?
Terra left again and she was hurt...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}！
我现在该怎么办？
我该怎么做？
泰拉又离开了，而且她受伤了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
And I just stood here...doing nothing.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
而我只是站在这里...什么也没做。

scripts.text: You have a strong sense of responsibility.
scripts.translation: 你有强烈的责任感。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
......anyways.
I couldn't either stop her, or follow her...
What now...?
Why did she take the Bradium...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
......总之。
我既没能拦住她，也没能跟上她...
现在该怎么办...？
她为什么要拿走魔力之石...？

scripts.text: - You tell Arc about the Giant from the cave. -
scripts.translation: - 你告诉阿克关于洞穴里的巨人。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? Is that what happened?
Bradium...is certainly a precious ore for Sapha.
They use a refined Bradium ore...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什么？是那样吗？
魔力之石...确实是萨法珍视的矿石。
他们使用精炼魔力之石...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You said that a Sapha was hurt?
And its body was already stiff?
Impossible!
Terra!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你说有一只萨法受伤了？
而且它的身体已经僵硬了？
不可能！
泰拉！！

scripts.text: - Arc suddenly began gathering up his gear. -
scripts.translation: - 阿克突然开始收拾装备。 -

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Where was that cave where you found that Sapha?
There was no such cave when we inspected our surrounding areas.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你发现那只萨法的洞穴在哪里？
我们巡视周边区域时，并没有这样的洞穴。

scripts.text: What are you trying to do?
scripts.translation: 你想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Can't you see?
I'm going out to look for Terra. She took the Bradium with her, it has got to be something to do with that Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你没看出来吗？
我要出去找泰拉。她带走了魔力之石，这肯定和那只萨法有关。

scripts.text: Is it okay for you to leave your post?
scripts.translation: 你擅离职守没关系吗？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
It's.. ...
...No....
Shit, then what should I do!!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
这... ...
...不行....
该死，那我该怎么办！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will go. I'm the one who knows exactly where that cave is.
I will go and bring her back.
If Terra headed for that cave, I should be able to find her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我去吧。只有我知道那个洞穴的确切位置。
我会去把她带回来。
如果泰拉去了那个洞穴，我应该能找到她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's hear rest of the story from Terra.
It is important for you to guard this place, isn't it?
If Terra really took the Bradium without any permission...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我们听听泰拉剩下的故事吧。
对你来说，守卫这里很重要，不是吗？
如果泰拉真的未经许可就拿走了魔力之石...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
The higher ups won't just remain still...
I'm sorry to ask you but...
Please go and bring her back here...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
上级不会坐视不管的...
抱歉麻烦你了，但是...
请去把她带回来...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I'm really sorry for getting you into this mess.....
...Please, find Terra.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
真的很抱歉把你卷进这堆麻烦里.....
......请，找到泰拉。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What? A wounded Laphine in the Sapha's village?
Was it Terra?! Was she captured by those Sapha bastards?!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
什么？萨法的村庄里有一只受伤的拉菲尼？
是泰拉吗？！她被那些萨法混蛋抓住了吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I couldn't check out exactly who the captured Laphine was.
And they seem to have no intention of harming the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点。我无法确切确认被抓住的拉菲尼是谁。
而且他们似乎没有伤害拉菲尼的意图。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Also, they were looking for something that can cure a wounded Laphine...
If we bring some medicine to them, we might have a chance to see who the Laphine is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
另外，他们在寻找能治疗受伤拉菲尼的东西...
如果我们给他们带些药，也许就有机会看到那只拉菲尼是谁。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand how anxious you feel.. but that is the only way I can think of finding out who it is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我理解你的焦急...但这是我唯一能想到的确认身份的方法。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will take some things to treat the wounds with me and if it turns out that the captured Laphine is Terra, I will bring her back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会带上一些治疗伤口的东西。如果被抓的拉菲尼是泰拉，我会把她带回来。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
..........
OK, that seems like the best thing we can do for this situation...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
......
好吧，看来这是目前我们能做的最好的事了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Do you by any chance know about the 'Yggdrasil'?
There's nothing better than the Yggdrasilberry to treat wounds...
Especially for us Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你听说过“世界树”吗？
没有什么比世界树浆果更适合治疗伤口了...
尤其是对于我们拉菲尼来说...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
If you have a Yggdrasilberry, you can use it to cure that Laphine...
.Yggdrasil is the tree of life... its roots are in touch with everything in this world.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果你有一枚世界树浆果，可以用它来治疗那只拉菲尼...
世界树是生命之树...它的根系与这个世界的一切相连。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I have...
...only three Yggdrasilberries...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我这里有...
...只有三枚世界树浆果...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I will give you these but they won't be enough...
Outside... there is a huge tree... where the root of the Yggdrasil is exposed.... it should be there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我会把这些给你，但数量不够...
外面...有一棵巨树...那里露出了世界树的根系.... 应该就在那里。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Sometimes you can find Yggdrasilberries around there.
Go find few more and bring them with you. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
有时候你可以在那里附近找到世界树浆果。
去多找几枚带在身上。快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Arc]
There's a huge root of the tree near a swamp at the outskirts of this area.
That's where the tree of life's root is exposed.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
在这片区域边缘的沼泽附近，有一根巨大的树根。
那就是生命之树根系暴露的地方。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You should be able to find some Yggdrasilberries there.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你应该能在那里找到一些世界树浆果。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
You will need at least 6~7 of them...
.... .. I hope she is safe..
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
你至少需要6到7枚...
.... .. 希望她平安无事..

scripts.text:
[Arc]
As soon as you are done collecting the berries, bring them to the Sapha Village right away!!!
Terra... please be safe.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
采完浆果后，立刻把它们带到萨法的村庄!!!
泰拉...请一定要平安。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
...Oh where is Terra...?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
...泰拉在哪里...？

scripts.text:
[Arc]
{0}!!
Terra's back!!!
She is back in one piece!
...She hasn't been saying a single word since her return, I told her to rest in Yai...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
{0}!!
泰拉回来了!!!
她完好无损地回来了！
...她回来后一直一言不发，我让她在雅伊休息了...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Please come by if you don't mind...
Terra's Yai.
Which is her Private Residence... It's located at the Southeast direction from here.
I would like to hear a detailed account of what happened.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
如果不介意的话，请过来一趟...
泰拉的雅伊。
那是她的私人住所...位于这里的东南方向。
我想听听事情经过的详细描述。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
What happened....while she was gone?
I would like to hear a detailed account fn what happened...
Please go to Terra's Yai later.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
她不在的时候...发生了什么？
我想听听事情经过的详细描述...
请稍后去泰拉的雅伊。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
I really appreciate what you've done for us.
But, I'm worried about Terra.
I hope she can be her old self...
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
我非常感激你为我们所做的一切。
但我担心泰拉。
希望她能恢复从前的样子...

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Ah~Ah~Stop right there...
This area is off-limits to unauthorized personnel.
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
啊~啊~站住...
此区域禁止未经授权的人员进入。

scripts.text:
[Arc]
Yur,Dur AnoVa?
Wha? Dieb OsaDur .. 
ah..RuffThus NeAsh. man nesAsh OdesAlah ?
scripts.translation:
[阿克]
Yur,Dur AnoVa?
Wha? Dieb OsaDur .. 
ah..RuffThus NeAsh. man nesAsh OdesAlah ?

scripts.text: - I can't understand what he's saying... Oh god how frustrating. -
scripts.translation: - 我听不懂他在说什么... 天哪，真让人沮丧。 -

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
NeiVil !
narNoth nesMush.
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
NeiVil !
narNoth nesMush.
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!

scripts.text: - We don't seem to understand eachother. -
scripts.translation: - 看来我们彼此都不理解对方。 -

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Halt.
This area is restricted unless you have been given permission.
Especially to outsiders like you.
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
站住。
除非获得许可，否则禁止进入此区域。
尤其是像你这样的外来者。

scripts.text:
[Splendide Guard]
Tal-!
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
Agoltas Me...
scripts.translation:
[辉煌领域卫兵]
Tal-!
AnuDur AmanDana Goth nar!
Agoltas Me...

scripts.text: - Looks like we don't understand each other. This could be troublesome... -
scripts.translation: - 看来我们彼此都不理解对方。这可能会很麻烦... -

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
仔细观察，发现有一根打结的茎...
看起来这是阿克告诉我的泰拉的痕迹。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing toward the^4d4dff Southern^000000 direction.
scripts.translation: 打结的叶片指向^4d4dff南方^000000。

scripts.text:
This is a marking Terra left to remember the way back home.
A knotted leaf is pointing^4d4dff South^000000.
scripts.translation:
这是泰拉留下的标记，用来记住回家的路。
打结的叶片指向^4d4dff南方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
仔细观察，发现有一根打结的茎...
看起来这是阿克告诉我的泰拉的痕迹。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing ^4d4dff East^000000.
scripts.translation: 打结的叶片指向^4d4dff东方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
A closer look reveals that there's one knotted stem...
It looks like this is Terra's trace that Arc told me about.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
仔细观察，发现有一根打结的茎...
看起来这是阿克告诉我的泰拉的痕迹。

scripts.text: A knotted leaf is pointing ^4d4dff North^000000.
scripts.translation: 打结的叶片指向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text:
Weeds are easy to find around here...
There's nothing too special about it.
scripts.translation:
这里很容易找到杂草...
没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text:
There are footprints here as well as signs that someone has fallen.
It looks like someone was fighting here?
But who?
scripts.translation:
这里有脚印，还有有人摔倒的痕迹。
看起来有人在这里战斗过？
但是是谁呢？

scripts.text: There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation: 有脚印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text:
Someone must have had a fight here.
There are footprints heading ^4d4dffNorth^000000.
scripts.translation:
有人一定在这里战斗过。
有脚印通向^4d4dff北方^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 这里的脚印似乎通向某个地方。

scripts.text:
There's evidence that there was a fight here too.
These footsteps can't be a Laphine's...
scripts.translation:
这里也有战斗过的证据。
这些脚印不像是拉芬留下的......

scripts.text: There are footprints that lead to^4d4dff the Root of a huge tree^000000.
scripts.translation: 有脚印通向^4d4dff巨树的根部^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints that lead to^4d4dff the Root of a huge tree^000000.
scripts.translation: 有脚印通向^4d4dff巨树的根部^000000。

scripts.text: There are footprints here that seem to be leading towards something.
scripts.translation: 这里的脚印似乎通向某个地方。

scripts.text:
There's a stem entangled inside an opening in the roots of a huge tree...
It looks like something slipped here.
scripts.translation:
在巨树根部的缝隙里有一根纠缠的茎...
看起来有什么东西掉进来了。

scripts.text: A cold breeze is blowing out from deep inside the tree.
scripts.translation: 一股冷风从树的深处吹出来。

scripts.text: Follow the trace.
scripts.translation: 追踪痕迹

scripts.text: Looks dangerous... head back.
scripts.translation: 看起来很危险... 回去吧

scripts.text: You take a one step forward carefully through the muddy roots and slip.
scripts.translation: 你小心翼翼地穿过泥泞的树根，却滑了一跤。

scripts.text:
It's too dark to see anything inside...but it feels like there's a big hole at the bottom.
I'd better step back...It looks dangerous.
scripts.translation:
里面太黑了，什么都看不见...但感觉底部有个大洞。
还是退回去吧...看起来很危险。

scripts.text: Between huge roots, there is a hole leads to the underground cave.
scripts.translation: 巨大的树根之间，有一个通向地下洞穴的洞口。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 进去看看

scripts.text: I'm not going in there.
scripts.translation: 我不进去

scripts.text: Again, you slip through the muddy roots.
scripts.translation: 你又一次在泥泞的树根间滑倒了。

scripts.text: You decide to come back later.
scripts.translation: 你决定稍后再来。

scripts.text:
Strange looking stems are entangled inside an opening of huge roots.
Surface looks unstable...I should step away before I slip on it.
scripts.translation:
巨大的树根缝隙里纠缠着形状奇怪的茎。
表面看起来很不稳定...我最好退开，免得滑倒。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
您的物品栏已满。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text: This is the only spot where sunlight is shining down through a hole in the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 这是唯一有阳光透过天花板洞口照射进来的地方。

scripts.text: Looking up I see the roots of the tree and stems digging up a mud-plastered wall, so the sunlight could shine through....2.j...There is a statue of Giant on the ground.
scripts.translation: 抬头望去，只见树根和茎蔓穿透了泥墙，阳光才得以透进来...2.j...地上有一尊巨人的雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A statue in a place like this...
Interesting.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在这种地方竟然有一尊雕像...
真是有趣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm, This resembles... that giant tribe in Manuk...
Huh? It's wearing a muffler...
...It can't be!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这看起来像...马努克的那个巨人部族...
咦？它戴着围巾...
...不会吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It has a lot of scars on it... as if it had been in a severe fight...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它身上有很多伤疤...看起来像是经历过一场恶战...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And it appears like it's holding something in its arms...
Just what happened here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且它似乎怀里抱着什么东西...
这里到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't imagine what happened here, but I don't see Terra's marks anymore...
and this cave looks unsafe... I'd better go back to Arc for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想象不出这里发生了什么，但我已经看不到泰拉的痕迹了...
而且这个洞穴看起来很危险...我先回去找阿克吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Could it be... Terra was fighting this Giant?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
难道说...泰拉在和这个巨人战斗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyways... How do I get out of here?
That hole I came in is too slippery to climb back out...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不管怎样...我怎么出去呢？
我进来的那个洞太滑了，爬不回去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Light is coming in from the ceiling above... Maybe I should just climb a stem around here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天花板上方有光透进来...也许我可以爬一下附近的茎蔓...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm done with this place.
I should go back to Arc...
Let's find an exit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受够了这个地方。
我得回去找阿克...
找找出口吧。

scripts.text:
I came back here, but there's no trace of Terra...
There's only one thing different from the last time..Small particles of an ore are sprinkled around the Sapha's dead body.
scripts.translation:
我又回到了这里，但没有泰拉的踪迹...
唯一和上次不同的是...萨法的尸体周围散落着一些矿石微粒。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...Terra was here.....
Powdered Bradium...
What was she trying to do with this Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...泰拉来过这里.....
粉末状的魔力之石...
她拿着萨法想做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't just go back to Arc without anything... he'd be so disappointed...
Hmm, Should I go to the Sapha's village?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什么证据都没带回去...阿克肯定会很失望...
嗯，我要不要去萨法的村庄看看？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't find any traces of Terra anymore.
One thing that bugs me is...These particles of an ore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我再也找不到泰拉的踪迹了。
让我在意的是...这些矿石微粒。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should go back to Arc and ask about it, or go to Sapha's Village and investigate some more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我应该回去找阿克问问，或者去萨法的村庄进一步调查。

A giant from the race called Sapha is petrified here.
It looks like it's dead...
scripts.translation:
这里石化了一个被称为萨法的种族的巨人。
看起来它已经死了...

scripts.text:
I need to bring back some evidence of this giant in the cave.
What should I bring with me?
scripts.translation:
我需要带回一些这个洞穴里巨人的证据。
我该带什么回去？

scripts.text: Hair
scripts.translation: 头发

scripts.text: Muffler
scripts.translation: 围巾

scripts.text: Pants
scripts.translation: 裤子

scripts.text: Fragment of Bradium
scripts.translation: 魔力之石碎片

scripts.text: It won't come off. It's as if it is a tree rooted on a rock.
scripts.translation: 拔不下来。就像扎根在岩石上的树一样。

scripts.text:
You carefully strip a worn muffler off of the Sapha's neck.
We will see if this muffler belongs to Ogen or not.
scripts.translation:
你小心地解下萨法脖子上磨损的围巾。
看看这条围巾是不是奥根的。

scripts.text: And...what else should I take?
scripts.translation: 还有...我还应该拿什么？

scripts.translation: 头发

scripts.text: Pants

scripts.translation: ...我不想脱一个死人的裤子...

还有什么？

Now I have the muffler, let's go back to Luik and Snorren.
scripts.translation:
石化的萨法。
现在我有围巾了，我们回去找卢伊克和斯诺伦吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen!!!!!!
...Ogen... Ogen...
....Ogeeen......
You don't mean..?
scripts.translation: 你的意思是..？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This.. is.. worse than I could have imagined.....
Ogen... this doesn't look like it can be reversed...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
这...比...我想象的还要糟糕.....
奥根...这看起来无法逆转了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
No matter how much bradium fluid we inject... Ogen can't come back alive...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
无论我们注入多少魔力之石...奥根都无法复活了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... really was adament... about protecting that Laphine... to protect Terra.....
He did his best 'til the last...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
奥根...真的非常执着...为了保护拉菲娜...为了保护泰拉.....
直到最后一刻...他都尽力了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Look at this, {0}...
His petrifyied body...
protected Terra...like this.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
看看这个，{0}...
他石化的身体...
就这样保护着泰拉。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... made himself an unbreakable shield...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
奥根...把自己变成了一面坚不可摧的盾牌...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ogen... you can now go back to the bosom of the Motherland...
This statue will be a monument to your courage...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
奥根...现在你可以回到母亲的怀抱了...
这座雕像将成为你勇气的纪念碑...

scripts.text: - - I can't begin to describe the sorrow of losing a close friend... -
scripts.translation: - - 失去挚友的悲痛...难以言表... -

scripts.text: - All I could do was to keep tapping his shoulder... as he quietly sobbed... -
scripts.translation: - 我能做的...只是轻轻拍着他的肩膀...看着他无声地哭泣... -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's.. go back...
Ogen wouldn't want you to be so sad and depressed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们...回去吧...
奥根不会希望你如此悲伤消沉的。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I guess you are right...
There's... sunlight shining here...
This... must be a comfort resting place for Ogen.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你说得对...
这里...有阳光照耀...
这...一定是奥根安息的地方。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I should go and tell Luik and the townspeople about this...
I will go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我得去告诉卢伊克和镇上的居民这件事...
我先走了。

scripts.text:
- Snorren stood up with a bitter smile...
...I should go back too... I'm worried about Terra. -
scripts.translation:
- 斯诺伦带着苦涩的笑容站了起来...
...我也该回去了...我很担心泰拉。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, I almost forgot the ring.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀，差点忘了戒指。

scripts.text:
Ogen... was petrified as he covered Terra...
What was going on between them that they would see past their racial differences...?
scripts.translation:
奥根...石化时正护着泰拉...
他们之间发生了什么，竟能超越种族的隔阂...？

scripts.text: Before you is a statue made of stone and wood. It's so life-like it's eerie.
scripts.translation: 眼前是一座由石头和木头制成的雕像。栩栩如生，令人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
The trunk of a Tree moderately stretched upward.
There are big thorns here that should be enough to use as footholds to climb up.
scripts.translation:
一棵树的树干向上延伸。
上面长着粗大的荆棘，足以作为攀爬的落脚点。

scripts.text:
It's the trunk of a Tree stretched out toward a hole in the ceiling.
Big thorns can be used as footholds.
scripts.translation:
树干伸向天花板上的一个洞。
粗大的荆棘可以作为落脚点。

scripts.text: Climb up.
scripts.translation: 攀爬上去

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
By the way, how did that Fairy come this far?
Is she captured?
scripts.translation:
[村民 拉维内]
顺便问一下，那个妖精是怎么跑到这么远的？
她是被抓来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
No, She's not.
That Fairy came here by her own accord.
How impudent. She was horribly wounded when she got here.
scripts.translation:
[村民 里维埃]
不，不是。
那个妖精是自己来的。
真是大胆。她来的时候伤得很重。

Are they talking about Terra..?!)

[{0}]
（嗯？妖精？受伤了？
他们说的是泰拉..?!）

scripts.text: Break into their conversation.

scripts.text: Keep quiet and listen.

你们刚才在说一个妖精，能告诉我详细情况吗？

Outsider!!
Why is he here?
scripts.translation:
[村民 拉维内]
外来者！！
他为什么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
We weren't saying anything.
There's nothing to tell you.
Lawine, Come with me to the Refinery later.
scripts.translation:

我们什么也没说。
没什么好告诉你的。
拉维内，稍后跟我一起去精炼厂。

captured Fairy may be Terra. -
scripts.translation: - 萨法人不愿意透露任何信息。但那个被抓的妖精可能是泰拉。 -

scripts.text:
[Villager Lawine]
I heard a fairy was crying and begging, she was badly hurt.
scripts.translation:
[村民 拉维内]
我听到一个妖精在哭喊求救，她伤得很重。

scripts.text:
[Villager Rivier]
No one understand the words of fairy...
In the end we had no idea what to do.
scripts.translation:
[村民 里维埃]
没人听得懂妖精的话...
最后我们也不知道该怎么办。

do not forget.

对了，把羽毛收好。
今天我们要去精炼厂，别忘了。

scripts.translation:

啊！是个外国游客！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation: - 幸好，萨法人以为我听不懂他们的话，但他们一定是在说泰拉... -

scripts.translation: - 萨法人正在交谈，没有注意到我的动作。 -

scripts.text: - They are talking mostly about common town matters, not much useful information. -
scripts.translation: - 他们主要谈论的是城镇的琐事，没什么有用的信息。 -

scripts.text: - I'd better move away from them before they get suspicious of my presence. -
scripts.translation: - 我最好在他们起疑之前离开这里。 -

我们什么时候允许外来者进来参观的？
没错...你甚至听得懂我在说什么吗？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
He seems anxious as he wanders back and forth..
Is he the guard of this prison?
scripts.translation:
他似乎很焦虑，来回踱步着...
他是这座监狱的卫兵吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
.. Argh.. Why not?!
What a blockhead...
Hmm?
Who are you?!
How could an outsider be here...?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
...啊...为什么不行？！
真是个笨蛋...
嗯？
你是谁？！
一个外来者怎么会在这里...？

scripts.text: About the Captured Fairy.
scripts.translation: 关于被捕获的妖精。

scripts.text: What is this place?
scripts.translation: 这是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
How does an outsider like you know that?
And..? What? How can you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
像你这样的外来者怎么会知道这件事？
而且...？什么？你怎么能听懂我在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Helloo...?
Can you understand the words coming out of my mouth?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你好...？
你能听懂我嘴里说出的话吗？

scripts.text: - I show the ring to Snorren. -
scripts.translation: - 我向斯诺伦展示戒指。 -

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Aha! Now I understand...
That's amazing. a ring capable of interpreting between different languages... and you were able to come all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
啊哈！现在我明白了...
这太神奇了。一枚能在不同语言间进行翻译的戒指...而且你竟然能一路来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I heard there are outsiders helping our people.
You must be one of them!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我听说有外来者在帮助我们的族人。
你一定是其中之一！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
But where did you hear about that Fairy?
Frankly, I want to have a word with that Fairy.
But I don't understand their language.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
但你是从哪里听说那个妖精的？
说实话，我想和那个妖精谈谈。
但我听不懂她们的语言。

scripts.text: Why do you want to talk to her?
scripts.translation: 你想和她谈什么？

scripts.text: Do you need an interpreter?
scripts.translation: 你需要翻译吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
An interpreter? Certainly!
But I can't just do it arbitrarily...
The reason why I want to have a word with that fairy, I mean Laphine...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
翻译？当然需要！
但我不能随便就去做...
我想和那个妖精，也就是拉芬妮谈谈的原因...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I... want to find out if she's got anything to do with my friend...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我...想知道她是否和我的朋友...有关...

scripts.text: Your friend?
scripts.translation: 你的朋友？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah. Ogen is missing.
He said he was curious about the area you are living in and went to check it out. How foolish of him.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
是的。奥根失踪了。
他说对你居住的地区很好奇，就跑去查看了一下。真是愚蠢透顶。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
And he never came back.
After quite a while, that fairy came.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
然后他就再也没有回来。
过了很久之后，那个妖精出现了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I don't know what guts she had to just fly into our territory.
That fairy just kept on yelling 'a bradium!' 'a bradium!'
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我不知道她哪来的胆子，竟然直接飞进我们的领地。
那个妖精一直在那喊“魔力之石！”“魔力之石！”

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Our village's vigilantes are saying that fairy is affected by the power of bradium and went crazy.
That's what Laphine are all like!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我们村庄的义警们说那个妖精被魔力之石的力量影响而发疯了。
拉芬妮她们都是这样的！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
They just try to make accesories out of the ore which is our source of life.
They collect anything that possesses magical power.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
她们只是想用这种作为我们生命源泉的矿石制作饰品。
她们会收集任何拥有魔力的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You should calm down a bit... Tell me about that captured Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你应该冷静一点...告诉我关于那个被捕获的拉芬妮的事。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Right, I'm sorry.
Anyways, shortly after Ogen went missing the fairy appears... this is too suspicious...
and that fairy was severely wounded too.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
好的，对不起。
总之，就在奥根失踪后不久，那个妖精就出现了...这太可疑了...
而且那个妖精也受了重伤。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I think...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我想...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
That fairy attacked Ogen as he was trying to peek on your camp.
And she was drawn by Ogen's bradium and came all the way here to find more bradium!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
那个妖精是在奥根试图窥探你们营地时袭击了他的。
她被奥根身上的魔力之石吸引，一路追到这里来寻找更多的魔力之石！

scripts.text: That could be right...
scripts.translation: 也许是这样...

scripts.text: I don't see it that way...
scripts.translation: 我不这么认为...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But does that Ore called bradium really possess an overwhelming magical power?
It didn't seem like that...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是那种被称为魔力之石的矿石，真的拥有压倒性的魔力吗？
看起来并不像那样...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really? But, we Sapha can't live without bradium.
This war with the Laphine... is to protect the bradium from them...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
真的吗？但是，我们萨法人离不开魔力之石。
这场与拉芬妮的战争...就是为了保护魔力之石不被她们夺走...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see...
Your people and their people are fighting over the bradium...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了...
你们的人和她们的人正在为魔力之石而战...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is... Is that so?
Then how do you see this situation?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
是...是这样吗？
那你如何看待这种局势？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It just occurred to me...
It's like some kind of forbidden area...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我突然想到...
这就像某种禁区...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyhow, You are going to ask that fairy about Ogen, right?
If that's the case, I could interpret between you two...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，你要去问那个妖精关于奥根的事，对吧？
如果是这样，我可以帮你们翻译...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah?!
Then just wait here for a sec!
I will go and ask Luik about this!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
真的吗？！
那你先在这里等一下！
我去问问卢伊克这件事！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh, Ah~!
This is a prison.
You need to obey the rules to keep a peaceful group life.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
呃，啊~！
这里是监狱。
你需要遵守规则，才能维持和平的集体生活。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
This is where people who break the rules are kept overnight.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
这里是关押违反规则的人过夜的地方。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Oh. I'm not one of them.
I just have some business here.
Snorren is a good Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
哦，我不属于他们。
我只是来这里办点事。
斯诺伦是个好萨法人。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Umm.. Hold on a sec...
Luik. It's me. Snorren.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
嗯...等一下...
卢伊克，是我，斯诺伦。

scripts.text:
[Voice through the door]
Ah, I told you it's not possible Snorren!
I can only put you in a cell for one night!
scripts.translation:
[门后传来的声音]
啊，我告诉过你不可能，斯诺伦！
我只能让你在一个牢房里待一晚！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yikes-! Luik, It's not that!
I brought someone who would interpret that fairy's words!
till, Can't I come in?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
哎呀-！卢伊克，不是那样的！
我带了一个能翻译那个妖精话语的人来！
那么，我不能进去吗？

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Shut up! Anyway, we have more things to worry about. This Laphine, we need to treat her wounds...
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克的声音]
闭嘴！总之，我们有更多事情要担心。这个拉芬妮，我们需要治疗她的伤口...

scripts.text:
[Luik's Voice]
Her body is completely different from ours. What should we do?
Hey, Snorren! Bring me anything. Anything like herbs!
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克的声音]
她的身体构造和我们完全不同。我们该怎么办？
嘿，斯诺伦！给我带点东西来。任何像草药的东西！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Herbs? Is her condition that bad?
Can't we fix her with bradium?
Oh right, She's not Sapha, ey?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
草药？她的情况那么严重吗？
我们不能用魔力之石治好吗？
哦对了，她不是萨法人，对吧？

scripts.text: Nothing gets past you...
scripts.translation: 什么都瞒不过你...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Do you have anything on your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你有什么心事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She's a Laphine, right? Then we should ask a Laphine about it...
Like what we need to treat her...
I can take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她是拉芬妮，对吧？那我们应该问问拉芬妮...
比如我们需要用什么来治疗她...
我可以去办。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Really?
Then hurry up and bring something back...
We will wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
真的吗？
那就快点带点东西回来...
我们会在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I think I have no choice but to go back and ask Arc....)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我想我别无选择，只能回去问问阿克了....）

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Hurry up and go find a way to cure this Laphine...
Then Luik might let us in.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
快点想办法治好这个拉芬妮...
那样卢伊克可能就会让我们进去了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Did you find a cure?
This.. is one strange looking fruit.
I saw this fruit from time to time, but never thought this would be a cure..?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你找到解药了吗？
这...是一种看起来很奇怪的水果。
我时不时会看到这种水果，但没想到它会是解药..？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I will take everything you've brought with you!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我会收下你带来的所有东西！

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Now, Let's go inside!
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
现在，我们进去吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...this won't be enough....
I would need at least 6~7 of these...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...这还不够....
我至少需要6~7个这样的...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Is something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Ah, I think we would need more than what I've brought here... I'll be back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？哦，我想我带来的这些还不够...我马上回来。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I already told Luik everything about you...
Let's go inside.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我已经把关于你的一切告诉卢伊克了...
我们进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I've been waiting for you...
Let's make haste.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我一直在等你...
我们快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I'm really confused now...Should I believe your story or not.
If it is true that cave really exists and Ogen is hurt...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我现在真的很困惑...我该不该相信你的话。
如果那个洞穴真的存在，而且奥根受伤了...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
The approximate location is...
Huge Roots of a tree. Got it.
You go ahead first. I will stop by at a refinery and be right after you.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
大概的位置是...
巨大的树根。明白了。
你先走，我去一趟精炼厂，马上就到。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Since that place is Laphine's territory, I will go quitely so they won't notice me.
You just go on ahead, I will be right behind you.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
既然那个地方是拉芬妮的领地，我会悄悄过去，以免被它们发现。
你先走，我马上就到。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
You are back. .. Luik wanted me to tell you this...
Terra, that Laphine, is free now.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你回来了...卢伊克让我告诉你...
泰拉，那个拉芬妮，现在自由了。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
We are tired of fighting. We didn't even want to start...
And we saw her true intention before everything else.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我们厌倦了战斗。我们甚至不想开始...
而且在一切发生之前，我们就看到了她的真实意图。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Go and check if Terra went back to her home safely...
Ogen... He went back to Mother Nature.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
去确认一下泰拉是否安全回到了家...
奥根...他回归了大自然。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
I really don't think what Ogen did was the right thing to do...
But that was... Ogen...
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
我真的不觉得奥根做的是对的...
但那是...奥根...

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Forgive me, I'm a bit depressed...
I'd rather just rest here.
I really appreciate what you've done.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
请原谅，我有点消沉...
我只想在这里休息一下。
非常感谢您所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Come back anytime...
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
随时欢迎回来...
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
What do you think of this muffler?
This belonged to Ogen...
Does it look good on me?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
你觉得这条围巾怎么样？
这是奥根的...
我戴着好看吗？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Outsiders shouldn't be here without permission.
Please get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
外人没有许可不能来这里。
请离开。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Ids ad?
Ns ai dha si asd!
Ms dfaa sd a.
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
Ids ad?
Ns ai dha si asd!
Ms dfaa sd a.

scripts.text: The doors are locked... I can't get in.
scripts.translation: 门锁住了...我进不去。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
您的物品栏已满。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
She's unconscious.
I can see a bandage to stop the bleeding...
Looks like Luik did it.
scripts.translation:
她昏迷不醒。
我看到有绷带在止血...
看来是卢伊克做的。

scripts.text:
Luik and Snorren did everything to extract juice out of a Yggdrasilberry
chopped and stuffed it into a mouth and paste them on the body...
scripts.translation:
卢伊克和斯诺伦为了榨取世界树浆液，
切开了浆果塞进嘴里，然后涂抹在身体上...

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Finally she's coming to.
Ok, {0}, it's up to you now.
And you better not fake any of the words she's saying.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她终于醒了。
好了，{0}，现在轮到你了。
你最好别伪造她说的任何话。

scripts.text: - I nod to Luik and began talking to the Laphine. -
scripts.translation: - 我向卢伊克点头示意，开始与拉菲尼交谈。 -

scripts.text: - After the Laphine gained her full consciousness, she gazed around and spoke in shaky voice. -
scripts.translation: - 拉菲尼完全恢复意识后，环顾四周，用颤抖的声音说道。 -

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Where... am I?
Oh My! That's right! I need Bradium!
Get me out of here!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
我...在哪里？
天哪！对了！我需要魔力之石！
快放我出去！

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
If I don't go back to him quickly, he... he is going to die!!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
如果我不快点回去找他，他...他就要死了！！

scripts.text: Who is HE?
scripts.translation: 他是谁？

scripts.text: Is your name Terra?
scripts.translation: 他叫泰拉吗？

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
A giant... a giant in a cave...
He...He got hurt trying to protect me...
He wouldn't move!
His body was getting cold.
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
一个巨人...洞穴里的巨人...
他...他为了保护我受了伤...
他动不了了！
他的身体正在变冷。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
We were each other's enemy......
but he saved me...
I heard they need a bradium to live!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
我们本是敌人......
但他救了我...
我听说他们需要魔力之石才能活命！

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
Give me some bradium. Hurry!
I can't be late!
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
给我一些魔力之石。快！
我不能迟到！

scripts.text: You are Terra. Right?
scripts.translation: 你是泰拉，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Terra]
How...How do you know my name?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
你...你怎么知道我的名字？
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Arc asked me to find you. So I came here.
By the way.. You were saying about a giant, do you mean a Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是阿克让我来找你的。所以我来了这里。
顺便问一下...你刚才提到一个巨人，你是指萨法吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Sapha in the cave...
His body was already petrified when I got there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洞穴里的萨法...
我赶到那里时，他的身体已经石化了。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Giants.. It is said that the Sapha people are cursed to be petrified.
And that the Bradium is what prevents them from becoming petrified.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
巨人...据说萨法一族被诅咒会石化。
而魔力之石可以防止他们石化。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So I tried to bring a bradium to him... ...
But he... Sob...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以我试着给他带了一块魔力之石... ...
但是他...呜...

scripts.text: - Terra couldn't continue to talk as she was agonizing in the pain from her wounds. -
scripts.translation: - 泰拉因伤口的剧痛而痛苦不堪，无法继续说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Why did she break down like that? What did she say?
Tell me what she said!!!
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她为什么突然崩溃了？她说了什么？
告诉我她说了什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
How...How do you know my name?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
你...你怎么知道我的名字？
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came looking for you on behalf of Arc.
Just how did you end up here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是受阿克之托来找你的。
你究竟是怎么落到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Terra]
To find a... Bra.. dium.
That's right. Bradium! Give me a bradium!!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
去找...魔...力之石。
没错。魔力之石！给我一块魔力之石！！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
A giant... a giant in a cave...
He...He got hurt trying to protect me...
He wouldn't move!
His body was getting cold.
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
一个巨人...洞穴里的巨人...
他...他为了保护我受了伤...
他动不了了！
他的身体正在变冷。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
We were each other's enemy......
but he saved me...
I heard they need a bradium to live!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
我们本是敌人......
但他救了我...
我听说他们需要魔力之石才能活命！

scripts.text:
[Terra]
Give me some bradium. Hurry!
I can't be late!
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
给我一些魔力之石。快！
我不能迟到！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Sapha in the cave...
His body was already petrified when I got there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洞穴里的萨法...
我赶到那里时，他的身体已经石化了。

[Terra]
Giants.. It is said that the Sapha people are cursed to be petrified.

scripts.translation:

巨人...据说萨法一族被诅咒会石化。
而魔力之石可以防止他们石化。

scripts.text:
[Terra]
So I tried to bring a bradium to him... ...
But he... Sob...
scripts.translation:
[泰拉]
所以我试着给他带了一块魔力之石... ...
但是他...呜...

scripts.text: - Terra couldn't continue to talk as she was agonizing in the pain from her wounds. -
scripts.translation: - 泰拉因伤口的剧痛而痛苦不堪，无法继续说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Why did she break down like that? What did she say?
Tell me what she said!!!
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她为什么突然崩溃了？她说了什么？
告诉我她说了什么！！！

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Let that Fairy rest for a while, now tell me what you were talking about.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
让那个妖精先休息一会儿，现在告诉我你们刚才在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
She's just too exhausted and fell asleep...
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她只是太累了，睡着了...
别打扰她。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
She can leave any time she likes.
It feels so dry in here.
Oh well, that's normal.
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
她想走随时都可以走。
这里感觉好干燥。
算了，这很正常。

scripts.text:
She's unconscious.
I can see a bandage to stop the bleeding...
Looks like Luik did it.
scripts.translation:
她昏迷不醒。
我看到有绷带在止血...
看来是卢伊克做的。

scripts.text:
[Luik]
Ier er ee ras d?
Ye ada sd?
Nffd..?
scripts.translation:
[卢伊克]
Ier er ee ras d?
Ye ada sd?
Nffd..?

scripts.text:
[Wounded Laphine]
...Riveh...AshIman Or mah...
..ah..Thor..ThorOsa Yee Lu..ung...
scripts.translation:
[受伤的拉菲尼]
...Riveh...AshIman Or mah...
..ah..Thor..ThorOsa Yee Lu..ung...

You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
您的物品栏已满。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Here, Luik. He said this is a cure for Laphine.
Should we just let her eat it as it is?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
给，卢伊克。他说这是拉菲尼的解药。
我们要不要直接让她吃下去？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Uh.. and your name was..?
scripts.translation:
[斯诺伦]
呃...还有，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Snorren]
Yeah, Right.

scripts.text:

用魔力将数据输入宝石...这是科技做不到的事...虽然有点不甘心承认，但这确实很了不起。

那么，我得着手制造一台能读取宝石中魔法数据的机器，这样我们就能立刻使用它们了。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, it seems like my skin is becoming really dry.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
最近，我的皮肤似乎变得非常干燥。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It looks like you're carrying too many things.
Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
看起来你携带了太多物品。
为什么不把一些物品存入仓库，然后再回来呢？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I do not have any need of your help right now.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
萨法的未来掌握在你手中。
我现在不需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, someone who came from Schwarzwald gave me a small mineral as a gift from his home town when he saw our study of Bradium.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
最近，一位来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的人看到我们在研究魔力之石，便送了一块来自他家乡的小矿石作为礼物。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Oh! Yes, that's it!
This much will be enough!
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
哦！是的，就是这个！
这些足够了！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
The future of the Sapha is up to you.
I wish you good luck.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
萨法的未来掌握在你手中。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I don't know if it's caused by the cold weather or our chronic disease getting worse.
It hasn't been too long since we administered the Bradium, so why.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我不知道这是由寒冷天气引起的，还是我们的慢性病恶化了。
我们使用魔力之石的时间并不长，为什么会这样呢。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Huu... You see, we are afraid of such things... What a hard life.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
呼...你看，我们害怕这样的事情...真是艰难的生活。

scripts.text: A chronic disease?
scripts.translation: 慢性病？

scripts.text: Bradium?
scripts.translation: 魔力之石？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
We Sapha, who are descendants of Hwergelmir, survived and rebuilt the Giant tribe in the flood of the blood of Ymir.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我们萨法，作为赫瓦格密尔的子孙，在尤弥尔的血流洪水中幸存下来，并重建了巨人部落。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
For no apparent reason, we developed a chronic disease that makes our bodies dry and harden over time just like an old tree.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
不知为何，我们患上了一种慢性病，使我们的身体像老树一样随时间变得干燥和硬化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I think that this is the curse of Ymir who bled by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我想这是被众神放血的尤弥尔施加的诅咒？

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But we couldn't just wait for death to slowly creep up on us and exterminate our entire race.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
但我们不能只是坐以待毙，看着死亡慢慢逼近并灭绝我们整个种族。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
To heal this rare disease the smartest Sapha studied and studied.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
为了治愈这种罕见疾病，萨法中最聪明的族人进行了反复的研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
What they found was that by injecting a refined Bradium, which is buried around Jotunheim, it can postpone the progression of the disease.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
他们发现，注射埋藏在约顿海姆周围的精炼魔力之石，可以延缓病情的恶化。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
So all of the giants of Sapha established their towns around mines to get Bradium easier.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
因此，萨法的所有巨人都选择在矿脉附近建立城镇，以便更容易获取魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
It seems the amount of buried Bradium is enough.
But for the eternal prosperity of our tribe, and to make the vaccine for this incurable disease, we have to study more and more.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
目前埋藏的魔力之石数量似乎还足够。
但为了我们种族的永恒繁荣，以及研制出针对这种绝症的疫苗，我们必须进行更深入的研究。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Bradium is the stem of our life.
But the buried Bradium will be exhausted someday, so we Scientists have to find an alternative for our descendants.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
魔力之石是我们生命的支柱。
但埋藏的魔力之石终有一天会枯竭，所以我们科学家必须为后代寻找替代品。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Recently, we've learned that there are various minerals in the human world Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
最近，我们得知人类世界米德加尔特拥有各种各样的矿石。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Now the world called Midgard is
like a holy place for us,
which can bring the wind of
revolution for us.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
如今，被称为米德加尔特的世界对我们来说宛如圣地，
它能为我们带来变革的契机。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
Contact with Midgard
must be the lead of Hwergelmir
for us, the Sapha which has such
a closed-off society.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
对于像我们萨法这样封闭的社会来说，
与米德加尔特建立联系，
必定是赫瓦格密尔指引的方向。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I'll draw a result that can
satisfy his lead!
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
我将得出一个能令其指引满意的结果！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I can't say for sure until now,
but this mineral seems to have
many interesting features.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
目前我还无法确定，
但这种矿石似乎具有许多有趣的特性。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
As I examine this mineral
more and more, it's really
different from the one in Jotunheim.
This mineral must be helpful
to make a new vaccine!
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
随着我对这种矿石研究的深入，
发现它与约顿海姆的矿石截然不同。
这种矿石一定能帮助研制新的疫苗！

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
But the amount of the mineral
is too little to make a
preparation for the
examination.
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
但这种矿石的数量太少，
不足以制备用于检测的样本。

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
You said you're from Midgard, right? Do you think you can bring me a little bit more of that mineral..
scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]
你说是从米德加尔特来的，对吧？你觉得你能再帮我带一点那种矿石来吗...

^FF0000{0}^000000.

scripts.translation:
[救生员博士]

^FF0000{0}^000000的。
我想^FF0000{1}^000000应该就够了。

[Dr. Lifeguard]
I'll give you this portable toolbox.
Things like a detector and a little hammer for mining minerals are included in this toolbox.

我把这个便携式工具箱给你。
里面装有探测器和小锤子等用于开采矿石的工具。

helpful in collecting
the minerals I need.

scripts.text:
[Dr. Lifeguard]
I really appreciate your help.

非常感谢你的帮助。

It looks like you're carrying too many things.
Why not put some of your items in storage and come back?
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
看起来你携带的东西太多了。
为什么不把一些物品存入仓库，然后再回来呢？

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I've heard that some strangers from Midgard are around here, it must be you.
I'm Grenouille, a scientist.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我听说有一些来自米德加尔特的外乡人在附近，一定是你们吧。
我是格勒努伊，一名科学家。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
It's been a long time since
the Laphine built the Splendide camp here
and confronted each other.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
拉斐恩人在这里建立辉煌领域营地，并相互对峙，已经很久了。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
A number of soldiers who
left their hometown Alfheim are
restraining them with fighting against
the harsh cold of Jotunheim
for the holy duty and the faith to
stop the evil attempts to
sickening Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
许多离开家乡阿尔弗雷姆的士兵，为了神圣的职责和阻止邪恶势力侵蚀世界树的信念，正在与约顿海姆的严寒搏斗，以压制他们。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
They're well trained soldiers,
and their captains hold them in high esteem,
so they're enjoying a
comfortable life there.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
他们是训练有素的士兵，他们的船长对他们评价很高，所以他们在那里过着舒适的生活。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
But there's a saying that
constant dripping water
wears away the stone.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
但俗话说，水滴石穿。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
Continuous small battles without big progression
makes the soldiers in Splendide exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
持续的小规模战斗而没有大的进展，让辉煌领域的士兵们精疲力竭。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
One day, someone began to sing
a song of Alfheim, that spread rapidly...
Now they strongly
miss their hometown.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
有一天，有人开始唱一首关于阿尔弗雷姆的歌，这首歌迅速传开了...
现在他们非常想念家乡。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
I was so worried about them and
I finally found a way to
save them from the deep sadness.
I hope you to help me to do that.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
我很担心他们，
终于找到了一个方法
让他们摆脱深深的悲伤。
希望你能帮我做到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
There's a Laphine General
who is called Flowery,
in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
在辉煌领域，
有一位被称为“花儿”的
拉菲涅将军。

scripts.text:
[Grenouille]
She is a collecting maniac,
so her house is always
in a mess with miscellaneous
things. Flowery must have
seeds from the flowers
of Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[格勒努伊]
